name: post.edit
description: Changes a post's hook, caption, accounts, media or whole composer draft. A write made from an older copy is refused with the post as it is now. An account taken off a post takes its waiting job with it, so nothing goes to an account the post no longer names; a scheduled post left with no job stays scheduled, as planned.
sql:
with nc as (
  select case when :channels::jsonb is null then null
    else array(select c from jsonb_array_elements_text(:channels::jsonb) with ordinality t(c, n) group by c order by min(n)) end as chans
),
dropped as (
  delete from brandbase.post_jobs j using nc
  where nc.chans is not null and j.post_id = :id and j.brand_id = :brand and j.status not in ('live', 'uploading')
    and not (j.channel = any (nc.chans))
  returning j.id, j.status
),
edited as (
  update brandbase.posts p set
    hook = coalesce(:hook, p.hook),
    caption = coalesce(:caption, p.caption),
    channels = coalesce(nc.chans, p.channels),
    media = coalesce(:media::jsonb, p.media),
    draft = coalesce(:draft::jsonb, p.draft),
    marked = case when p.marked is null and exists (select 1 from dropped d where d.status in ('scheduled', 'failed'))
        and not exists (select 1 from brandbase.post_jobs j where j.post_id = p.id
          and j.status in ('scheduled', 'live') and not exists (select 1 from dropped d where d.id = j.id))
      then 'scheduled' else p.marked end,
    version = p.version + 1,
    updated_at = now()
  from nc
  where p.id = :id and p.brand_id = :brand
  returning p.*
)
select brandbase.post_json(to_jsonb(e), coalesce((
  select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(j)) from brandbase.post_jobs j
  where j.post_id = e.id and not exists (select 1 from dropped d where d.id = j.id)), '[]')) as result
from edited e
